reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Fixed Allow for re-executions of istio-iptables by skipping apply step if existing rules are compatible", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: Re-executions of istio-iptables skip applying rules when existing rules are compatible, instead of re-applying them.

proposed.statement: istio-iptables re-executions now skip the apply step when existing iptables rules are compatible.
